How do you check the results in these case studies?

We use SEO tools like Ahrefs, SEMrush, and Google Search Console to track traffic, keyword rankings, and backlinks. This allows us to show before and after results so you can trust that the numbers are accurate and real.

Will my business get the same results?

Not exactly. Results depend on competition, website strength, and content quality. The case studies show that good link building can help improve traffic and rankings, but every website is unique, so results will vary.

How long does it take to see results?

Most campaigns show results in 3 to 6 months, but it can take longer for very competitive industries. Link building is a long-term strategy, and the impact grows over time as your website gains authority.

What kinds of links are built? Are they safe?

All links are editorial and from high-authority websites. They are safe for SEO and follow Google’s guidelines. These links help improve your rankings without risking penalties from search engines.

Why do some campaigns get more growth than others?

Every website starts at a different level. Some have strong content or authority, while others need more work first. The case studies show why results vary and how strategy changes based on the website’s starting point.

How do you choose which pages and keywords to target?

We pick pages and keywords based on search volume, competition, and conversion potential. We focus on pages that can get the most traffic and leads so the links deliver the highest value for your business.
